title: Barkpark Studio schema type

icon.description: Its icon, a desk icon name: a list row, reference or search hit with no media draws it, as Sanity draws the type's icon.

listPreview.description: A list row: {title, subtitle, media} field names.

fieldsets.description: Sanity's fieldsets for the document's own fields, as a composite's.

crossValidations.description: Cross-field rules: [{name, title, rule, level, fields}]. The studio shows a broken one under each field it names; Barkpark checks them on write.

desk.description: Desk settings: orderings, views; incoming: lists, in the form, of the documents that reference this one, with Add item (Sanity's incoming references input); preview, a URL template (:slug, :id) for Presentation; previewView: true or {title} adds a Preview tab; hidden: true keeps the type off Barkpark's desk while its URLs still open (barkpark#22789); translations: {languages: [{id, title}], languageField?} makes it a translated type (docs/EXTENDING.md).

hidden.description: Off the desk; the type still opens from a direct URL.

incoming.description: Lists in the form of the documents that reference this one. It is no field and holds no value.

name.description: Its name, unique in the type.

title.description: Its label; the name, start-cased, without one.

group.description: The field group (tab) it shows on; without one, under all fields only.

types.description: The referring types: {type, by} (by: the reference field, or array of references, that points here), or {view} for the relation a desk.views entry declares.

creationAllowed.description: false: no Add item. A list of template ids: only those. Default true.

translations.description: Document translations (Sanity's @sanity/document-internationalization): one document per language, linked in a group.

languages.description: The languages: {id, title}, or the id alone.

languageField.description: The field that holds a document's language (default "language"); the form hides it.

singleton.description: One document, whose id is the type's name.

prefill.description: A new PortableDoc document's starting blocks.

kind.description: "document" or "object" (a named type other schemas use as a field type; never offered for creating).

visibility.description: "public" or "private": who may read its documents.

actions.description: Barkpark document actions the type declares.

cors_origins.description: Origins allowed to read it from a browser.

readerWrites.description: What a read seat may write on this type (barkpark#22790): {create, patchFields}; studioComment uses it so Viewers comment (J49).

required.description: The field must have a value.

min.description: At least this many characters, items, or this number. date, datetime: the earliest date (ISO or "now"), studio only.

max.description: At most this many characters, items, or this number. date, datetime: the latest date (ISO or "now"), studio only.

pattern.description: A regular expression the text (or a slug's current) must match; Barkpark enforces it on write.

unique.description: arrayOf: no two items with the same reference or value.

message.description: What to say instead of the default text.

length.description: Studio only: exactly this many characters, or items (blocks in richText).

precision.description: Studio only: number: at most this many decimal places.

positive.description: Studio only: number: 0 or above (Sanity's positive()).

name.description: Studio only: pattern: the name its message uses instead of the regex.

invert.description: Studio only: pattern: the text must NOT match. Barkpark still checks the pattern itself on a save (it reads no invert), so a save is refused or warned on the opposite values until it does.

assetRequired.description: Studio only: image, file: a value must hold an asset (alt text alone is not one).

refType.description: reference: the type it points to.

to.description: reference: the types it may point to, [{type}].

options.description: Type-specific: select's choices (a list, or {list, direction} as Sanity's), slug's source, image's hotspot, file's accept, reference's filter, an array's insertMenu ({filter, groups, views: list/grid, showIcons}) and collapseItemsAfter, a Portable Text field's oneLine (its text one block, as Sanity's), …

group.description: The field group (tab) it shows in.

validation.description: A rule, or a list of rules.

fallbackChain.description: localizedText: the order readers fall back through.

format.description: richText: "portableText" or "portableDoc", the stored format. localizedText: "plain" or "rich".

blocks.description: richText: the block vocabulary (styles, lists, marks, annotations, of, inline: inline objects [{name, fields}]). The Portable Text input takes its toolbar from it.

preview.description: An array item's row: {title, subtitle} subfield names.

visibleWhen.description: Shown only when {field, operator, value, scope?} holds.

hidden.description: true keeps the field out of the form whatever visibleWhen says; its value stays (a manual order's orderRank).

readOnly.description: true, or a condition like visibleWhen.

fieldsets.description: composite: Sanity's fieldsets, [{name, title, options: {collapsible, collapsed, columns}}].

fieldset.description: The fieldset (of its composite) it shows in.

weak.description: reference: Sanity's weak reference: a pick stores {_ref, _weak: true}, as Sanity's.

deprecated.description: Sanity's deprecated, {reason}: a "deprecated" badge by the title and the reason under it; the field stays editable. On a richText blocks.of / blocks.inline entry: shown disabled in Insert, the reason its tooltip. An array member keeps it (Sanity's array menu offers it as usual).

namedType.description: An array member or composite that is a named object type: Barkpark sets it when it expands the type. Its item row draws that type's icon. "code" makes it Sanity's code field (options: language, languageAlternatives, withFilename). "table" makes it Sanity's table field (options: rowType).

refTypeTolerant.description: reference: resolve the target as any type.

refTypes.description: reference: the types it may point to (another spelling of `to`).

source.description: slug: the field it derives from (also options.source).

alt.description: image: true shows an alt input.
